mutations.original: DEFAULTS = {name: k.default for name, k in KEYS.items()}
mutations.mutated: DEFAULTS = {name: k.default for name, k in KEYS.items() if k.choices is None}
mutations.note: DEFAULTS silently drops every enum key -- on_divergence, status_detail, sync_removals vanish.

mutations.original: ENV_MAP = {name: k.env for name, k in KEYS.items()}
mutations.mutated: ENV_MAP = {name: k.env.lower() for name, k in KEYS.items()}
mutations.note: Env vars lose their CCS_ casing, so no environment override is ever found.
The valid set becomes a literal COPY again -- the exact two-sources drift the table removed.

mutations.original:
default: object
    env: str
    explain: str
mutations.mutated:
default: object
    env: str
    explain: str = ""
mutations.note: explain becomes optional, so a key can be added with no explanation at all.
A choice is dropped from the table -- the validator would then reject a value the explanation still names.
